title: Senior Manager, Product Design - Security
description:
The Datadog Security design team (K9 Design, as we lovingly call it) is hiring a senior product design manager to lead design across our security products. This is a chance to shape an industry-leading experience for a new kind of Datadog user: security practitioners who need to catch threats where they start, stop them when they land, and shut down exposures before they turn into something worse.

You'll lead a team of designers at various stages of their careers across cloud, code and data security, turning an overwhelming amount of signal into something a security team can act on. The goal: build the security product people want to spend their day in. You'll own the design, push for excellence, and partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to get there.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do

• Lead design direction across your team's products, and hold the bar for design excellence end to end: interactions, visual detail, consistency and cohesion.

• You're in the work. Run critiques, give direct and useful feedback, and push the team toward bolder, more opinionated solutions rather than safe ones.

• Coach and grow designers across our Paris, Madrid and New York offices, helping each of them do the best work of their careers.

• Help define a security design system built on top of Datadog's existing components, with the security practitioner's workflows in mind.

• Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to evolve cross-platform thinking, shape roadmaps, and to set how the three disciplines work together day to day.

• Take accountability for the product and business outcomes your team's design work influences.

• Bring AI fluency to how your team works, from how design gets explored and validated to how it gets shipped.

Who you are

• 10+ years in design, including experience leading and growing high-performing teams.

• A design leader first: a user advocate with a sharp eye for detail, strong taste and the willingness to get into the work and give direct feedback.

• A track record of leveling up a team's output, with before-and-after examples of how your leadership transformed the design of a product.

• You've led complex products or features: a zero-to-one launch, a reimagining of something established, or both.

• A strong communicator who collaborates effectively with executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Able to demonstrate AI fluency, either in your own work or in how you've led teams through it.

• Comfortable navigating the technical complexity of modern software development and cloud infrastructure.

• Ideally : security domain experience, or a portfolio of information-dense, data-rich interfaces. Industry-leading work on complex B2B, B2C or consumer products counts for just as much here.

Benefits and Growth

• Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space

• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities for internal mobility

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

• Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: System Support Analyst I
description:
Role Overview
The System Support Analyst serves as the primary technical resource for InteleShare customers, ranging from major hospital networks to small radiology facilities. This remote position operates on a night shift schedule providing real-time technical support through substantial phone interaction and direct customer engagement. The role ensures InteleShare software is properly configured and operating effectively at all times, delivering timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining exceptional service levels and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities: The Customer Support Analyst is accountable for delivering expert technical support and ensuring optimal system performance through the following priorities:

• Provide responsive technical support by addressing customer problems via phone and portal, actively monitoring client sites, and resolving cases in a timely manner while managing and exceeding customer expectations through excellent service delivery.

• Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by analyzing root causes and troubleshooting challenging problems relating to software applications, Windows operating systems, SQL Server databases, and related technologies to restore system functionality and minimize downtime.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation by logging all incidents and problems within ServiceNow ticketing system, ensuring accurate records that support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of support operations.

• Configure and deploy software solutions by installing and configuring InteleShare software to assist in customer deployments, editing configuration files, and ensuring systems meet customer operational requirements.

• Ensure service level compliance by prioritizing work based on service level agreements (SLAs), escalating incidents beyond current skill set to appropriate teams, and consistently meeting or exceeding Support specifications.

• Contribute to knowledge management by participating in knowledge sharing activities, publishing Knowledge Base articles, and supporting ad hoc projects to improve InteleShare support operations

• The hours for this role are Monday-Friday first shift (starting workday around 8am AEDT)

Qualifications & Experience

• 2+ years of experience in Windows administration and technical customer support

• Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems for both servers and workstations

• Demonstrated customer service excellence with strong client-facing skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English or equivalent

• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with high attention to problem description, detail, and impact

• Proven ability to work effectively under pressure in a client-facing environment

• Ability to work remotely using secure connections, phone, and remote desktop-sharing tools

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Experience running queries in SQL databases

• Excellent knowledge of Mac OS

• Experience with SaaS or cloud environments

• Experience in medical or research environments, including familiarity with DICOM, HL7, HIPAA, Healthcare IT (HIT), medical imaging systems, PACS (Picture Archiving and Communication System), or RIS (Radiology Information System)

title: Head of Market Resolution
description:
Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. As the Head of Market Resolution you will own the rules, data sources and operating systems used to resolve markets. The role sits at the intersection of product, data, operations, legal and risk: every resolution must be timely, auditable and consistent with the market’s published terms.
What you will own

• Design the resolution framework, source hierarchy, decision rights, service levels and exception process.

• Create clear, testable resolution criteria before markets launch, reducing ambiguity and dispute risk.

• Select and govern authoritative data providers and official sources.

• Build fallback procedures for delayed, corrected, conflicting or unavailable source data.

• Automate high-confidence resolutions with product and engineering while preserving human oversight.

• Lead disputed resolutions and maintain complete evidence and decision trails.

What you bring

• 8+ years in exchange operations, market data, event settlement, trading operations, data products or comparable systems.

• Exceptional ability to write precise rules and anticipate edge cases.

• Experience evaluating data quality, source reliability, dependencies and operational resilience.

• Comfort working across technical, legal and commercial teams under time pressure.

• Strong judgment, intellectual honesty and commitment to consistent outcomes.

Why Hacksaw Markets

• A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.

• An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.

• The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.

Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

- Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

- Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

- Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

- You're fluent in English as well as French or German to engage prospects across our European markets.

- Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors

- Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

- Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients

- Someone who is proficient in English and workplace proficient in at least one other language (preferably German, Spanish or French)

- Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

- Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

- Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's cool about the role

- Competitive pay and equity.

title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
As data centres become one of the largest and fastest-growing sources of electricity demand, Fuse is expanding into high-performance compute infrastructure at the intersection of energy and AI. We're building the GPU/CUDA performance layer and the inference serving layer at the same time, from scratch, and we're looking for the founding engineer to own the latter. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll own the layer above kernels and hardware: how models actually get served, scaled and delivered against committed performance targets. Few companies can pair real power delivery with real compute the way Fuse can, which puts inference serving at the heart of our offering.
Responsibilities

• Define Fuse's inference serving strategy and architecture from first principles

• Design and build the serving stack: request routing, batching, scheduling and autoscaling for high-throughput, latency-sensitive inference workloads

• Own model-level optimisation strategy for serving, deciding where and how to apply quantisation, distillation, speculative decoding and similar techniques to improve throughput and cost per token, partnering with the CUDA/GPU engineers

• Make the core software architecture calls on serving frameworks and orchestration (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server or equivalents)

• Translate throughput, latency and uptime commitments into concrete technical specifications and serving capacity plans

• Act as direct technical owner of inference performance and reliability

• Work closely with the CUDA and GPU engineering teams to integrate custom kernels and hardware performance work cleanly into the serving layer

• Set the standards, tooling and benchmarks this function will run on as it grows

Requirements

• 4+ years building or operating large-scale inference serving systems, or equivalent strong project/industry experience

• Deep, hands-on experience with inference serving frameworks and the techniques used to optimise them (batching, KV-cache management, quantisation, speculative decoding)

• Strong systems thinking, able to reason about the full path from incoming request to served response across a large cluster

• Comfortable working directly with GPU/CUDA engineers to integrate low-level performance work into a serving system

• A track record of making high-stakes architecture calls and owning the outcome

• Comfort operating without a playbook: this is a founding role shaping a new function, not joining an established one

• Bonus: Triton or custom ML inference/training frameworks; autoscaling or capacity planning for large-scale inference; multi-tenant serving or SLA-driven infrastructure; background at a hyperscaler, frontier AI lab or large-scale distributed inference system; Kubernetes/Slurm; interest in energy markets, grid systems or sustainability-focused compute

Benefits

• Competitive salary and eligibility for equity

• Biannual bonus scheme

• Fully expensed tech to match your needs

• Private health insurance

• Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

description:

As Stop Loss Lead, you’re the department’s technical authority, the person who makes sure eligible reimbursements get submitted, tracked, and collected instead of left on the table. •
Own reporting and audit readiness: Review and help prepare monthly stop loss and reimbursement reporting and carrier submissions, support internal and external audit requests, and keep documentation accurate and current.

•

• High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred

• Advanced claims processing and reimbursement experience strongly preferred

• Experience interpreting stop loss contracts and plan documents preferred

• Experience conducting audits, quality reviews, or process improvement initiatives preferred

• Experience training or mentoring team members preferred

Technical Skills:

• Advanced knowledge of stop loss administration, reimbursement processes, and contract interpretation

• Working knowledge of medical terminology and CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding (preferred)

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones.

With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.)

- Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Forward Deployed Engineers at Sentry help our largest customers get real value from Sentry, from integrating the SDK to making sure the right alerts and issues reach the right people at the right time. This role is a Senior Solutions Engineer who goes further: you'll help us build Sentry's forward deployed motion.

That means working shoulder to shoulder with our most important customers, often inside their codebases and workflows, instead of advising from the outside. When a customer's problem needs more than a best-practices doc, such as a custom integration, a tricky instrumentation setup, or a working prototype, you'll build it with them, then turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for the rest of the team.

Forward deployed work is new here and you will have a part in building this arm. You'll start with the core Solutions Engineering work and take on more hands-on deployment work as customers pull you into it, helping define what this motion looks like at Sentry. The goal is simple: reduce time to value. The outcomes we care about:

- Developers can quickly find and resolve slowdowns and errors in their applications.

- Customers get to value faster, and the lessons from each deployment make the product better for everyone.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Turn customer goals into a plan. Understand customers' pain points and objectives, then act as their trusted advisor, translating them into implementation plans, workshops, and best practices that show clear business value.

- Get Sentry set up, in the code. With the customer's permission, work in their codebase like a member of their engineering team, delivering the pull requests that fully set up Sentry so data is flowing from day one.

- Instrument what matters most. Add custom telemetry for a customer's most critical user journeys and build the dashboards and alerts that go with it.

- Lead migrations. Move customers off their existing observability tools by setting up their Sentry organization and delivering PRs that introduce Sentry and remove the old solution.

- Work like a trusted contractor. Stay within the scope and access you've been given, take extra care in live environments, test thoroughly, and ship pull requests that customer engineers are glad to merge. Embed with their teams, including on site, when it helps.

- Build the motion. Turn one-off deployments into repeatable playbooks and tooling, help define how forward deployed engagements are scoped and measured, and bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

 

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- You'd rather sit with a customer's engineers and fix the problem in their code than write them a recommendation

- Enjoy talking about technology and interfacing with engineers and engineering leaders.

- Appreciate working in a dynamic environment, on a variety of projects with customers from lots of different industries.

- Love flexing your creative brain by developing solutions, resources, and content from scratch (scripts, code samples, demos, sales-consumable collateral/documents, etc.).

- Have a fast-paced, results-driven mindset.

- Love developer tools, open-source, and/or all things software development life cycle!

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of experience, with some mixture being Software Engineering and Solutions Engineering/Implementation and at least 1+ year being a FDE

- Hands-on experience working with programming languages and frameworks including JavaScript, Python, Node.js, Java, PHP, .NET, Ruby, React, React Native, Mobile Native (iOS and/or Android), etc

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Staff Frontend Software Engineer to bring technical leadership, strong ownership, and strategic thinking to our frontend team. In this role, you will drive the development of high-impact web interfaces that integrate with our flight safety platform, enabling users to interact with complex aviation data and derive actionable insights. You will collaborate closely across disciplines and play a key role in advancing aviation safety and operational capability.

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement React-based features while architecting frontend systems that handle large-scale, real-time and historical aviation data.

- Integrate, process, and visualize data from multiple sources, including live streams and archived datasets.

- Mentor engineers and drive best practices through code reviews and architectural discussions.

- Partner with backend engineers, product managers, and UX/UI designers to make informed design and implementation decisions.

- Ensure reliable, maintainable frontend systems through automated testing, clear documentation, and strong engineering standards.

- Build reusable components and internal libraries to accelerate future development.

What Will Make You Successful

- 9+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, user-facing web applications.

- Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, state management, and modern web standards (HTML/CSS).

- Strong experience with asynchronous frontend patterns and efficient handling of live and historical data streams.

- Proven ownership of complex features or product areas, driving work from concept through delivery with a high degree of autonomy.

- Proactive, resourceful mindset with the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

- Consistently sets and upholds a high technical bar through design decisions, code quality, mentorship, and hiring input.

- Ability to analyze and optimize frontend performance for scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.

Bonus Points

- Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

- Experience with geospatial or mapping tools such as Mapbox or Cesium.

- Deep experience with live data streaming and playback systems.

- Experience with video streaming technologies and real-time media delivery.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

- Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents

- Time Off: 3 weeks PTO plus 13+ paid company holidays

- 401(k): Offered (no current employer match, but we are committed to enhancing this benefit in the future)

Due to U.S. export control regulations, we can only hire U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, Green Card holders, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum or refugee status). We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers. All work must be performed in the United States.

Beacon AI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit harassment or discrimination of any kind in the workplace and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

title: Technology/Supply Chain Planning Delivery Lead
description:
We Are:
Accenture Supply Chain & Operations practice who specializes at the intersection of functional consulting, data, & technology. Our Fortune 500 clients all the way through private equity-backed portfolio companies need big-picture change, so we come at their challenges from all sides with functional insights, data power, digital leadership, and extensive industry know-how. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in planning, procurement, manufacturing, fulfillment, and service while becoming more sustainable and resilient. How do we do it? We call out the most important metrics. We cut costs, optimize capital, improve response times and consider ESG values. We connect suppliers and customers across the extended supply chain. And we create strategies and operating models that really work.
You Are:
A Supply Chain and Operations professional who helps clients in implementing & optimizing the end-to-end planning process across supply chain and operations, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and driving efficiency. You will work with clients in leading & implementing Sales & Operations planning, demand planning, supply planning, production scheduling, and inventory management capabilities to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of products.
As part of the working with the clients, you lead & advise several aspects of integrated planning including:

• Integrated Planning Strategy: Develop and implement integrated planning strategies for clients that align with organizational goals, ensuring the optimal flow of goods and services from suppliers to customers.

• S&OP: Lead S&OP planning including S&OP cycle of demand review, supply review, pre-Exec & Exec S&OP reviews.

• Demand and Supply Planning: Develop Demand and supply planning processes for clients, including forecasting, production planning, procurement, and inventory management to balance supply with demand while meeting service level targets.

• S&OE: Enable strategic and tactical plans developed during the S&OP process and ensuring they are implemented smoothly across the supply chain. This includes ensuring production schedules, inventory management, order fulfillment, and logistics are aligned with business demand.

• Inventory Optimization: Develop inventory management strategies, ensuring optimal inventory levels across locations while reducing excess stock, stockouts, and working capital investment.

• Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve forecasting accuracy, and reduce lead times. Implement best practices and new technologies for enhanced planning and operations efficiency.

• Performance Management: Identify and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for supply chain performance, including on-time delivery, inventory turnover, and order accuracy. Develop action plans to address performance gaps

• Operating Model: Develop governance & operating model across sales, marketing, production, and logistics to integrate business needs and strategies into the planning processes.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Regularly communicate with internal stakeholders (e.g., executive team, sales, finance) to provide updates on planning performance and to ensure alignment on goals.

• Risk Management: Proactively identify potential supply chain risks (e.g., disruptions, supplier issues) and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on business operations.

• Reporting & Analytics: Provide insights into supply chain performance through data analysis and reporting, helping senior management make informed decisions on operational strategies.

The Work:

• Find solutions to clients’ supply chain and operations integrated planning related challenges

• Advocate leading practices, policies & procedures for integrated planning

• Spot and solve challenges using your analytical & strategy skills to dive into data and compare vs. industry peers

• Lead workshops that look for ways to improve organizations

title: Revenue Manager
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Revenue Manager to own revenue accounting end to end: how we recognize it, how we close it, and the systems that produce it. You'll report to our Controller and work closely with rev ops, sales, legal, and FP&A.

We sell through self-serve, enterprise contracts, and on marketplaces, with a mix of subscription, consumption, and self-hosted pricing as well as professional services. That mix makes revenue interesting. Prepaid credits, commits, overages, and multi-element deals all need clear policy and systems that get them right every month.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the accounting memos and also own how Salesforce, Metronome, and our ERP fit together so the numbers tie without a spreadsheet in the middle. We want someone who leans into AI. You'll use AI tools and agents to automate reconciliations, draft memos, and review contracts, and you'll help set how the rest of the accounting team works with them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

REVENUE RECOGNITION AND POLICY

- Own ASC 606 for every way we sell: subscription, consumption, self-hosted licenses, and marketplace

- Write and maintain technical accounting memos and our revenue policy

- Build and maintain our standalone selling price (SSP) analysis and run allocations on multi-element deals

- Set the treatment for prepaid credits, commits, rollover, overages, breakage, and promotional credits

- Set revenue positions for new AI and consumption products, and track partner and marketplace economics as those models evolve

- Review deals before signature and advise sales and rev ops on how terms affect revenue

CLOSE AND REPORTING

- Run the monthly revenue close: usage revenue, deferred revenue, contract assets, and unbilled AR, with rollforwards and reconciliations

- Reconcile usage data, Metronome, Salesforce, and the GL every month

- Own the allowance for credit losses, from methodology through the audit memo, with collections and sales

- Produce revenue and deferred revenue flux analysis, RPO, and disaggregation, and present results in quarterly close reviews

- Partner with FP&A to tie ARR and usage metrics to GAAP revenue

- Own commission capitalization under ASC 340-40

- Support special projects like new pricing launches and products

SYSTEMS

- Own the revenue data flow from Salesforce to Metronome to our ERP and revenue subledger

- Design revenue rules and configuration in our AI-native ERP, and review its output rather than rebuild it in spreadsheets

- Lead requirements, testing, and parallel runs for new systems, products, and pricing launches

- Build automated reconciliations, controls, and AI agents so the close scales with

title: Sr. Technical Character Artist I
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Job Description: Senior Technical Character Artist, VR

Join Axon and Be a Force for Good

At Axon, we're committed to our mission of Protecting Life. We stand at the forefront of tackling society's most pressing safety and justice challenges. Our approach combines innovative devices and cloud software into a comprehensive ecosystem, all driven by collaboration, empathy, and diverse perspectives from those we serve and work with. At Axon, you're not just a team member; you're a key player in a global mission to make a significant difference. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. We are on a moonshot mission to reduce police-related gun violence by 50% over the course of 10 years.

Build VR Solutions for Social Good

Police primarily go through 40 hours of in-service training a year outside of the academy, and most of that time goes to topics like firearms and CPR recertification. There is not enough time to train on everything police need to be aware of. Officers who do learn a skill at in-service practice it once or twice, then are expected to remember it eight months later, under stress. Our goal is training that is more accessible, more memorable, and done more frequently. We call this "Roll Call" training: training that can be done before and after a shift to keep skills sharp.

Public-safety training is broken. Today's training is ineffective, not scalable, and expensive. Axon's VR team creates engaging, effective training with scenario feedback, including Community Engagement Training and less-lethal weapon training (like TASER), so officers are prepared to use alternatives to Use of Force.

Most police interactions are verbal and non-verbal, so we emphasize hand gestures and natural language processing. The trainee's body language, what they say, and how they say it all shape how they interact with NPCs (Non-Playable Characters) in the scenario. A trainer observes these interactions and gives feedback in a post-training debrief, and every product ties back into the Axon ecosystem through Axon Academy, Axon Evidence, Axon Performance, and Axon Standards.

Your Impact

You will join an interdisciplinary team tackling the biggest challenges in public safety training head-on, including immersive VR-based empathy, coping and de-escalation training that helps officers engage with the communities they serve with greater awareness and safety.

As one of the expanding members of Axon's VR team, the Senior Technical Character Artist is the bridge between art and technology for our NPCs. Because most training is a conversation, the believability of our characters carries the training. You will own character creation and character technology for our standalone-headset training simulators, from MetaHuman-based workflows to parametric clothing and materials, and help the rest of the art team deliver the best possible content under our technical restrictions. You will partner with Art, Engineering, Content, UX and User Research to deliver the best immersive quality for our trainings.

This is a senior role. We expect you to work independently, own your area end to end, and take direction from the Lead Technical Artist and the Art Director rather than needing day-to-day management.

À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir.

Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais.À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez :

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

- Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

- Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

- Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

- Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

title: Medical Coder for Primary Care Clinic
description:
Job Title: Medical Coder
Employment Type: Full-Time WFH
Department: Primary Care Clinic
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Medical Coder to join our primary care clinic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in coding for primary care services and a thorough understanding of medical coding guidelines and regulations. This role is pivotal in ensuring accurate and compliant coding of diagnoses, procedures, and medical services to optimize revenue and support high-quality patient care.
Key Responsibilities:

•
Medical Coding:
Accurately code diagnoses, procedures, and services using ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines.

•
Chart Review:
Conduct thorough reviews of patient charts and medical records to verify the accuracy and completeness of coding and documentation.

•
Coding Audits:
Perform regular coding audits to identify areas for improvement and ensure adherence to coding standards and clinic policies.

•
Documentation Support:
Collaborate with physicians and clinical staff to clarify documentation and coding requirements. Provide guidance and training to ensure accurate and comprehensive documentation.

•
Compliance:
Stay up-to-date with changes in coding regulations, payer requirements, and industry standards. Implement necessary adjustments to maintain compliance and optimize reimbursement.

•
Training and Mentorship:
Mentor and train junior coders and clinical staff on coding best practices and updates. Lead internal training sessions to enhance team knowledge and skills.

•
Reporting:
Generate and analyze coding and billing reports to monitor performance, identify trends, and support decision-making processes.

Qualifications:

• Certification as a Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or equivalent.

• Minimum of 5 years of medical coding experience, preferably in a primary care or multi-specialty clinic setting.

• In-depth knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.

• Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, and primary care procedures.

• Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and coding software.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and cover letter to with the subject line "Senior Medical Coder Application - [Your Name]". Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
